The severity of the neck texture issue is likely underestimated; combined with the pose auditor's high risk score, it suggests a more pervasive 'AI smoothness' artifact rather than just local noise reduction. I will upgrade the texture anomaly severity to 3.0 due to the corroborating pose uncertainty.
